query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Jon Favreau',
  cast = 'Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark / Iron Man, Gwyneth Paltrow as Pepper Potts, Don Cheadle as James Rhodes / War Machine, Scarlett Johansson as Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow, Sam Rockwell as Justin Hammer, Mickey Rourke as Ivan Vanko / Whiplash, Samuel L. Jackson as Nick Fury',
  tagline = 'It''s not enough to be against something. You have to be for something better.',
  description = 'The sequel to the groundbreaking Iron Man finds Tony Stark dealing with the consequences of revealing his identity to the world. As the government demands he hand over the Iron Man technology, a new threat emerges from Russia in the form of Ivan Vanko, while rival weapons manufacturer Justin Hammer schemes to replicate the suit. Meanwhile, Tony must confront his own mortality as the arc reactor keeping him alive slowly poisons his blood.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/iron-man-2-2010-featured-a7iMVSYBgysWrFsdAudWVy.webp',
  youtubeTrailerId = 'wKtcmifd5Ik',
  budgetMillions = 200,
  worldwideGrossMillions = 624,
  domesticGrossMillions = 312,
  openingWeekendMillions = 128,
  rtCriticsScore = 72,
  rtAudienceScore = 71,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Iron Man 2 & The Rise of MCU Card Collecting

By 2010, the MCU was no longer an experiment — it was a phenomenon. Iron Man 2 expanded the card collecting universe significantly with the introduction of Black Widow and War Machine, two characters who would become mainstays in Marvel trading card sets for the next decade.

### Key Sets Featuring Iron Man 2 Characters

The **2010 Upper Deck Iron Man 2** trading card set was released alongside the film and features extensive coverage of the movie''s characters and scenes. This set includes autograph cards, sketch cards, and memorabilia cards that remain popular with collectors.

### Market Trends

Scarlett Johansson''s first appearance as Black Widow in this film makes any autograph card from this era particularly valuable. Don Cheadle''s introduction as War Machine also created new collecting opportunities. The 2013 Rittenhouse Iron Man 3 set retroactively covers Iron Man 2 characters as well, making it a key set for completionists.',
  keyCards = '- **2010 Upper Deck Iron Man 2 Autograph Cards** — First dedicated MCU sequel card set with auto redemptions
- **Scarlett Johansson as Black Widow Auto** — Her MCU debut makes these cards extremely sought-after ($3,000+)
- **Don Cheadle as War Machine Auto** — First appearance in the role, replacing Terrence Howard
- **2010 Upper Deck Iron Man 2 Sketch Cards** — Original 1/1 artwork by various artists
- **Mickey Rourke as Whiplash Costume Card** — Memorabilia cards with actual costume pieces
- **2013 Rittenhouse Iron Man 3 Base Set** — Covers IM2 characters retroactively',
  content = '## Tony Stark''s Biggest Challenge: Himself

Iron Man 2 takes the bold approach of making Tony Stark his own worst enemy. Fresh off revealing his identity to the world, Tony is riding high on fame and ego — but the arc reactor in his chest is slowly killing him. It''s a character study wrapped in a superhero sequel, and it works better than many give it credit for.

## The Legacy

- **Introduced Black Widow** — Scarlett Johansson''s Natasha Romanoff debuted here and became one of the MCU''s most beloved characters
- **War Machine Arrives** — Don Cheadle took over the Rhodes role and delivered the armored partner Tony needed
- **Nick Fury Expands SHIELD** — Samuel L. Jackson''s expanded role set up The Avengers
- **The Suitcase Suit** — The Mark V''s transformation scene remains one of the MCU''s most iconic moments
- **Howard Stark''s Legacy** — Introduced the idea of Tony''s father as a key MCU figure

## Fun Facts

- The Monaco Grand Prix sequence was filmed on a real racing circuit
- Sam Rockwell improvised much of Justin Hammer''s dialogue
- The ''new element'' Tony creates is later confirmed to be Vibranium in the MCU canon
- Elon Musk has a cameo at the Monaco restaurant scene
- The briefcase suit (Mark V) was designed by artist Adi Granov

## Viewing Context

Iron Man 2 is the **third film** in the MCU by release order. It takes place after Iron Man and The Incredible Hulk, and directly sets up The Avengers with its SHIELD subplot. The post-credits scene reveals Thor''s hammer Mjolnir in the New Mexico desert.',
  metaDescription = 'Iron Man 2 (2010) MCU movie guide — box office ($624M worldwide), cast, trading card market analysis, and collector tips. Explore Black Widow''s debut and War Machine''s arrival.',
  keywords = 'Iron Man 2, MCU Phase 1, Tony Stark, Black Widow debut, War Machine, trading cards, Marvel cards, 2010 Upper Deck, box office',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Topps Marvel Iron Man cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Iron Man 2 on Disney+?","answer":"Yes, Iron Man 2 (2010) is available to stream on Disney+ as part of the complete MCU collection. It is the third film released in the Marvel Cinematic Universe."},{"question":"How much did Iron Man 2 make at the box office?","answer":"Iron Man 2 grossed $624 million worldwide against a $200 million production budget. It earned $128 million on its opening weekend domestically and $312 million total in North America."},{"question":"Who plays Black Widow in Iron Man 2?","answer":"Scarlett Johansson plays Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow in her MCU debut. She appears undercover as Natalie Rushman before revealing herself as a SHIELD agent."},{"question":"What Iron Man 2 trading cards are valuable?","answer":"The most valuable Iron Man 2 cards include Scarlett Johansson autograph cards ($3,000+), 2010 Upper Deck sketch cards (1/1 originals), and Don Cheadle autographs as War Machine. Any first-appearance Black Widow card commands premium prices."},{"question":"Do I need to watch Iron Man 2 before The Avengers?","answer":"While not strictly required, Iron Man 2 introduces Black Widow, expands Nick Fury''s role, and sets up key Avengers plot points. The post-credits scene directly leads into Thor (2011)."}]',
  status = 'published',
  updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE slug = 'iron-man-2-2010'
